capabilities.body: OpenAmer ihlela umsebenti, iwente ngemathuluzi langempela — sitheminali, siphequluli, emafayela, ikhodi — bese igcina lokusebentile.
capabilities.title: Umsiti locabanga nawe

capabilities.body: Tingcoco, inkhumbulo nemamodeli kuhlala kulomshini. Kute lokulayishwako ngaphandle kwekutsi ucele.
capabilities.title: Umshini wakho, idatha yakho

capabilities.body: Tilwimi letingu-186, ngalunye ngendlela yekubhala loyifundzako. Sikrini sekucala seluhlelo sikubuta kutsi ufuna luphi.
capabilities.title: Lulwimi lwakho, ngendlela lefanele

capabilities.body: Emakhono agcinwa emsebentini lowentiwako, ngako imisebenti yamalanga onkhe iba mifishane nawuchubeka uyisebentisa.
capabilities.title: Likhono lelikhulako

help: Hlola kutsi lomshini uyakhona kufinyelela ku-inthanethi.
Phindza usebentise kusetha — tinyatselo letiphelile atiphindvwa.
Nangabe kwehluleka kabili, vula emalogi; imigca yekugcina isho sinyatselo.
failure.lead: Kute tingucuko letibuyiselwe emuva buthule — OpenAmer ima lapho ime khona, ngako kuyisebentisa kwesibili kuchubeka lapho.
failure.leadUpdate: OpenAmer isasenguculweni yangaphambilini futsi iyachubeka isebenta. Kute lokushintjwe kwayekelwa emkhatsini.
failure.title: Kusetha akukapheli

language.lead: Kusetha kuchubeka ngelulwimi lolukhetsa lapha. Ungalushintja kamuva eluhlelweni.
language.title: Khetsa lulwimi lwakho

progress.lead: Kusetha kwenteka kanye: OpenAmer ilanda lokudzingako futsi ilungisa lomshini. Nawuyivula kamuva, konkhe loku kuyeqiwa.
progress.leadUpdate: OpenAmer ifaka esikhundleni senguculo yangaphambilini. Tikhatsi takho tekusebenta, inkhumbulo netilungiselelo akutsintfwa.
progress.title: Kusethwa OpenAmer

stages.venv: Kwakhiwa indzawo yekusebentela lengasiyo yangempela ye-Python

cards.body: Vula luhlelo bese uchaza lofuna kwentiwe. OpenAmer isebenta ngemuva bese ikubikela.
cards.title: Cala ngemusho

cards.body: Tilungiselelo → Lokubonakalako → Lulwimi. Tindzawo telulwimi letingu-186, ungashintja nome kunini.
cards.title: Khetsa lulwimi lwakho

cards.body: Umsebenti lophindvwako uba likhono — ngekulandzelako udzinga umyalo munye.
cards.title: Yivumele ikhumbule

success.lead: Konkhe sekulungile. OpenAmer seyiyakho — kulomshini, ngelulwimi lwakho.
success.title: OpenAmer seyilungile

bullets: Isebenta kulomshini — tingcoco takho tihlala kulomshini
Tilwimi letingu-186, letifaka nendlela yekubhala loyifundzako
welcome.lead: Umsiti wakho. Emshinini wakho. Ngelulwimi lwakho.
welcome.leadUpdate: Inguculo lensha ye-OpenAmer seyilungile. Ingena esikhundleni senguculo yangaphambilini futsi igcina tonkhe tikhatsi tekusebenta netilungiselelo.
welcome.title: Siyakwamukela ku-OpenAmer
